payload.description_html: Ostriches are large, flightless birds found in Africa. They are the world's largest and heaviest living birds, known for their long legs and necks. Despite their size, ostriches are fast runners, capable of reaching speeds up to 45 miles per hour. They lay the largest eggs of any living land animal and have a unique adaptation for survival in their natural habitat, including powerful legs for defense and a keen sense of sight.
